result.topic_en: The page derives (m,n)πi/(6n) as the limit r→1 of the series Σ a_ν/ν. It justifies continuity at r=1 by bounding the partial sums A_ν, then sets up evaluation of Σ a⁰_ν/ν as a finite sum by Dirichlet's method using periodicity of the coefficients.

Limit formula expressing (m,n)πi/(6n) as the limit of a series
Bounded partial sums by pairing indices sn+σ and (s+1)n−σ, giving uniform convergence and continuity at r=1 (Dedekind's generalisation of Abel's theorem)
